rating_model.note: Two-pillar score (council decision, Nov 2026). Every source is mapped onto the Metacritic scale (a*x+b); critics and players are combined separately, and the score is their midpoint. Refit with care: see pipeline/rating.py. Steam: % positive is first adjusted for review count (SteamDB's formula), then mapped (fitted Nov 2026 on 101 games with 500+ reviews); with 500+ reviews it counts as a full player source on its own. Steam with 500+ reviews is never set aside as an outlier.
